layout.body:
TEMPORARY CLOSURE
Date: August 19
Dear Valued customers,
From September 1 to September 8, our store will be closed for business. The reason is that the state gas company, Pacific Gas, is digging up the main road outside our store to install some new gas pipes for our city. The road will be closed to both vehicles and pedestrians during this time.
During this temporary closure, our online and telephone order service will be fully operational. You can order goods through our secure website at www. thomasfabric. com or by calling this toll-free number 1-800-7401-0110. If you want to receive a catalogue of our merchandise, please call us at 1-800-8706-0603.
Our store will be open for business on September 9. We look forward to serving you again once the road work outside the store is complete.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.
Thomas Miller Store Manager

questions.stem: What is the purpose of this notice?

options.A: To advertise some new products to customers
options.B: To inform customers of a temporary store closure
options.C: To announce plans to enlarge a store
options.D: To advertise discounted prices for a gas company

questions.analysis: What is the purpose of this notice? Đáp án: B Bài gốc mở đầu: From September 1 to September 8, our store will be closed for business. Giải thích đáp án: cái này tức thì thông báo mục đích là báo cho biết khách hàng cửa hàng tạm thời ngừng kinh doanh.

questions.stem: According to the notice, how can customers place orders between September 1 and September 8?

options.C: By visiting the store in person
options.D: By going to a nearby store

questions.analysis: According to the notice, how can customers place orders between September 1 and September 8? Đáp án: B Bài gốc: our online and telephone order service will be fully operational Giải thích đáp án: khách hàng có thể thông qua trên mạng và điện thoại hạ đơn, Phương án dặm chỉ có B (điện thoại) Đúng.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from this notice?

options.A: People can walk on the main road during the maintenance period
options.B: Some new pipes will be installed
options.C: Customers can buy things from the store only by telephone

questions.analysis: What can be inferred from this notice? Đáp án: B Bài gốc: install some new gas pipes Giải thích đáp án: văn trung rõ ràng nói muốn lắp đặt mới đích khí than đường ống, bởi vậy B Đúng. A: con đường đối với người đi đường cởi mở → Sai, Bài gốc nói đúng cỗ xe và người đi đường đều Đóng C: chỉ có thể điện thoại mua sắm → Sai, còn có thể mua trên nết D: là tiệm sách → Sai, văn trung không có xách
